svg.title: Epoch and carrier phase have different evidence intercepts and outages
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Epoch and carrier phase have different evidence intercepts and outages
Unwrapped phase: separately qualified initial 0.01° state/path residual
Epoch: initial 200 ps from calibrated asymmetry and timestamp bound
Phase outage ≤ 11.104945 ms; epoch outage ≤ 31.617304 s.
Neither a 100 ps path bound nor returned packets supplies the 0.01° phase intercept.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
